sentences.target: Is that your family in the photo?
sentences.en: Is that your family in the photo?
sentences.fr: C'est ta famille sur la photo ?
sentences.pt: Essa é a tua família na foto?
sentences.zh: 照片里那是你的家人吗？
sentences.jp: 写真に写っているのはあなたの家族ですか？

sentences.target: Yes, it is. These are my parents and my little brother.
sentences.en: Yes, it is. These are my parents and my little brother.
sentences.es: Sí, lo es. Estos son mis padres y mi hermano pequeño.
sentences.fr: Oui, c'est ça. Ce sont mes parents et mon petit frère.
sentences.pt: Sim, é. Estes são os meus pais e o meu irmão mais novo.
sentences.kr: 네, 맞아요. 이분들은 저의 부모님이시고, 이 아이는 제 남동생이에요.
sentences.zh: 是的。这是我的父母和我弟弟。
sentences.jp: はい、そうです。こちらは私の両親と弟です。

sentences.target: Your brother looks very young. How old is he?
sentences.en: Your brother looks very young. How old is he?
sentences.es: Tu hermano parece muy joven. ¿Cuántos años tiene?
sentences.fr: Ton frère a l'air très jeune. Quel âge a-t-il ?
sentences.pt: O teu irmão parece muito novo. Quantos anos tem ele?
sentences.kr: 남동생분이 정말 어려 보이네요. 몇 살이에요?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟看起来很小。他多大了？
sentences.jp: 弟さんはとても若く見えますね。何歳ですか？

sentences.target: He is six years old. He is very active.
sentences.en: He is six years old. He is very active.
sentences.es: Tiene seis años. Es muy activo.
sentences.fr: Il a six ans. Il est très actif.
sentences.pt: Ele tem seis anos. Ele é muito ativo.
sentences.jp: 六歳です。とても活発です。

sentences.target: That is sweet. Does he like playing outside?
sentences.en: That is sweet. Does he like playing outside?
sentences.fr: C'est gentil. Est-ce qu'il aime jouer dehors ?
sentences.pt: Isso é querido. Ele gosta de brincar lá fora?
sentences.kr: 정말 좋네요. 밖에서 노는 걸 좋아하나요?
sentences.zh: 真可爱。他喜欢在外面玩吗？
sentences.jp: それは素敵ですね。外で遊ぶのは好きですか？

sentences.target: He loves it. We go to the park every weekend.
sentences.en: He loves it. We go to the park every weekend.
sentences.es: Le encanta. Vamos al parque todos los fines de semana.
sentences.fr: Il adore ça. Nous allons au parc chaque week-end.
sentences.pt: Ele adora. Nós vamos ao parque todos os fins de semana.
sentences.zh: 他特别喜欢。我们每个周末都去公园。
sentences.jp: 大好きです。毎週末、公園に行きます。
